data.title: Income tax assessment for 2025
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 for Frauke Beispielrade, resulting in a refund (Guthaben) of €715.00 to be transferred to her account.
data.explanation: The Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow has calculated your 2025 income tax and found a refund (Guthaben) of €715.00, which it will transfer to the bank account on file. Home-office costs were not recognised as a dedicated study, but a daily lump sum for 92 home-office days was applied instead. If you disagree with any part of the calculation, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, via the ELSTER portal, or in person for the record; the app shows you the deadline. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final and the refund will simply be paid out as stated.
data.tax_note: This is the official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for the 2025 tax year; keep it with your tax records as proof of the figures and the refund.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the tax assessment
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection with the Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow by the deadline shown, in writing, via the ELSTER portal, or in person for the record.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the assessment becomes final (bestandskräftig) and can no longer be challenged.
